title: Harry Potter
author: J.K. Rowling
short_summary: An orphaned boy who has always felt out of place discovers, on his eleventh birthday, that he is actually a wizard — and that he has been invited to attend a famous school of magic. There he makes his first real friends, learns spells and potions, and starts to uncover the truth about his parents and the powerful dark wizard who once threatened them.
extended_summary:
An orphaned boy who has always felt out of place discovers, on his eleventh birthday, that he is actually a wizard — and that he has been invited to attend a famous school of magic. There he makes his first real friends, learns spells and potions, and starts to uncover the truth about his parents and the powerful dark wizard who once threatened them.

As his first year at the school unfolds, the boy and his two closest friends begin to notice that something dangerous is hidden within the castle walls. Following a trail of clues, they realize the mystery is connected to the same dark wizard from his past — and that facing it will take more courage, loyalty, and quick thinking than any lesson could teach.

questions.prompt: What does the boy discover on his eleventh birthday?

options: That he has a twin brother
That he has won a contest
That he is moving to a new country

questions.explanation: He learns he's a wizard and is invited to attend a school of magic.

questions.explanation: Solving the mystery takes more than magic lessons — it takes quick thinking under pressure.

questions.prompt: Why do you think friendship matters so much when facing something dangerous?
questions.explanation: There's no single right answer — the story suggests that trust and teamwork make courage possible.

questions.prompt: The boy's two closest friends turn out to be essential for a reason beyond just company. Why?

options: Each of them brings a different strength to solving the mystery together

questions.explanation: It's teamwork, not magic alone, that lets the three of them get as far as they do.
